m Hi, Dr. Garcia. ® That software program you ordered
for our medical office just arrived—® the one that will
allow patients to schedule appointments online. Would
you like me to install it today?
w Oh, good. Actually, ®a service technician will be
stopping by tomorrow to install it for us. But could you
please let our patients know about this new option for
making appointments?
OK. ® Once the program is ready tomorrow, I'll send
an e-mail to our patients that will instruct them on how
to use the scheduling system.
